summary: Solid TypeScript code with good separation of concerns (types.ts, parser.ts, checker.ts, report.ts). Workflow has pinned actions & proper permissions, but critical gaps: references fixture files (lines 24–26: fixtures/*.json) without creating them—would fail in act. Uses curl for Bun instead of oven-sh/setup-bun action (line 13). No fixture setup step, test output validation, or act-result.txt generation mechanism. Hard-coded fixture paths reduce flexibility. Fixture files must be checked in or created dynamically for real CI.
